sentences.text: Biropristis was an extinct cartilaginous fish belonging to the family Sclerorhynchidae, a group of sclerorhynchoids.
Scientists know this animal only from isolated oral teeth found in central Chile.
The genus name honors Dr. Lajos Biró-Bagózcky, while the species B. landbecki commemorates Luis Landbeck, who first found the fossils.
This fish lived between 83.6 and 66 million years ago, from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian stages.
